desc: The WLAD Weapon Laser Aiming Device is a CLASS 1 laser consisting of a green visible aiming laser, a near-infrared (near-IR) aiming laser, IR illuminator and 300 lm LED illuminator. The function of the WLAD is to provide an operator with highly collimated aiming lasers for precision aiming and targeting visible in low light conditions and in conjunction with night vision devices for night time applications. The focusable near-IR Illuminator floods the area of interest with near-infrared light only visible when used with night vision devices. IP68 waterproof.
